    Elements of the colimit extension #

    Elementwise description of F(X) = colim_{U} Φ(U) (manuscript (1.1)): every element comes from some Φ(U), and an element of Φ(U) vanishes in F(X) exactly when it vanishes in some Φ(U') with U ⊆ U'.

    Module.Finite A M

    A module that is finite-dimensional over k is finitely generated over A.
